findings.claim: On a `SuppressSourceGeneration = true` type, a member with a KeyAttribute-derived key now hits `continue` before any further per-member processing. The README added in this same change says the analyzer still checks these for suppressed types. Ledger L12 exempts only the generation-only rules MsgPack011, 016 and 017. So an unserializable member type behind a derived key would go unreported.

findings.claim: The new `continue` after DoNotMixStringAndIntKeys runs whether or not SuppressSourceGeneration is set. The acceptance criteria say behaviour with SuppressSourceGeneration unset must not change.
